This stage performs the small number of derivations shared by several
analyses. Participant-level fields remain together in one wide cohort dataset;
only repeated QoL, TAOOH, ctDNA-sample, and alteration records are long.

```{r}
#| label: build-analysis-datasets

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
# force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
force <- TRUE
private_dir <- here::here(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data"))
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
validation_path <- file.path(result_dir, "input-validation.parquet")

if (!file.exists(validation_path)) {
  stop("Run 00-data/01-validate-inputs.qmd first.")
}

validation <- arrow::read_parquet(validation_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
domains <- c(
  "recruitment",
  "cohort_follow_up",
  "qol",
  "taooh",
  "ctdna_samples",
  "ctdna_analyses",
  "alterations"
)
output_paths <- c(
  recruitment = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-recruitment.parquet"),
  cohort_follow_up = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  qol = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-qol.parquet"),
  taooh = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-taooh.parquet"),
  ctdna_samples = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"),
  ctdna_analyses = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-ctdna-analyses.parquet"),
  alterations = file.path(result_dir, "analysis-alterations.parquet")
)
status_path <- file.path(result_dir, "build-status.parquet")
if (!setequal(validation$domain[validation$status == "validated"], c(domains, "consort_ipd"))) {
  stop("All eight private datasets must pass input validation.")
}

if (!force && all(file.exists(c(output_paths, status_path)))) {
  build_status <- arrow::read_parquet(status_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
} else {
recruitment <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "recruitment.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()
cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "cohort_follow_up.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()
qol <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "qol.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()
taooh <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "taooh.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()
ctdna <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "ctdna_samples.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()
ctdna_analyses <- arrow::read_parquet(
  file.path(private_dir, "ctdna_analyses.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame()
alterations <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "alterations.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()

required_columns <- list(
  recruitment = c("informed_consent_date", "randomization_date", "group_assignment"),
  cohort_follow_up = c(
    "id", "randomization_date", "tx", "diagnosis", "death_date",
    "follow_up_end_date", "status_death", "survival_time_days_unrestricted",
    "status_death_unrestricted", "potential_follow_up_days", "invitation_offered", "invitation_accepted",
    "enrolled_date", "last_known_alive_date", "mtb_date_first", "mtb_n_reports"
  ),
  qol = c("id", "assessment_id", "day", "q30", "baseline_q30"),
  taooh = c("id", "week", "y_taooh"),
  ctdna_samples = c("sample_id", "id", "sample_date", "valid_ctdna_result"),
  ctdna_analyses = c(
    "analysis_id", "sample_id", "id", "analysis_date", "lod_q1", "lod_q3",
    "valid_ctdna_result", "n_mut"
  ),
  alterations = c(
    "alteration_id", "analysis_id", "sample_id", "id",
    "found_in_solid_biopsy", "found_in_buffy_coat"
  )
)

datasets <- list(
  recruitment = recruitment,
  cohort_follow_up = cohort,
  qol = qol,
  taooh = taooh,
  ctdna_samples = ctdna,
  ctdna_analyses = ctdna_analyses,
  alterations = alterations
)
for (domain in names(datasets)) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns[[domain]], names(datasets[[domain]]))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(domain, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

if (anyDuplicated(cohort$id)) stop("cohort_follow_up must have one row per patient.")
if (anyDuplicated(ctdna$sample_id)) stop("ctdna_samples must have one row per sample.")

cohort$randomization_date <- parse_analysis_date(
  cohort$randomization_date,
  "randomization_date",
  allow_missing = FALSE
)
cohort$death_date <- parse_analysis_date(cohort$death_date, "death_date")
cohort$enrolled_date <- parse_analysis_date(cohort$enrolled_date, "enrolled_date")
cohort$last_known_alive_date <- parse_analysis_date(
  cohort$last_known_alive_date, "last_known_alive_date"
)
cohort$mtb_date_first <- parse_analysis_date(cohort$mtb_date_first, "mtb_date_first")
cohort$follow_up_end_date <- parse_analysis_date(
  cohort$follow_up_end_date,
  "follow_up_end_date",
  allow_missing = FALSE
)
source(here::here("R", "taooh-helpers.R"))
validate_taooh_follow_up(taooh, cohort)

cohort$tx <- validate_binary(cohort$tx, "tx", allow_missing = FALSE)
cohort$event_death <- validate_binary(
  cohort$status_death,
  "status_death",
  allow_missing = FALSE
)
# Dates have been shifted for privacy. The private preparation has already
# applied the primary endpoint censoring, so the public build must not compare
# shifted dates with the unshifted calendar data lock or truncate them again.
cohort$survival_time_days <- as.numeric(
  cohort$follow_up_end_date - cohort$randomization_date
)

ctdna$sample_date <- parse_analysis_date(ctdna$sample_date, "sample_date")
ctdna_analyses$analysis_date <- parse_analysis_date(
  ctdna_analyses$analysis_date, "analysis_date"
)
sample_dates <- ctdna[c("sample_id", "sample_date")]
ctdna_analyses <- merge(
  ctdna_analyses, sample_dates, by = "sample_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)
if (anyNA(ctdna_analyses$sample_date)) {
  stop("Every ctDNA analysis must refer to a sample with a recorded sample date.")
}
ctdna_analyses$attempted_sample <- !is.na(ctdna_analyses$sample_date)
lod_q1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(ctdna_analyses$lod_q1)))
lod_q3 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(ctdna_analyses$lod_q3)))
ctdna_analyses$ctdna_error_derived <- as.integer(
  ctdna_analyses$attempted_sample & is.na(lod_q1) & is.na(lod_q3)
)
ctdna_analyses$valid_ctdna_result_derived <- ctdna_analyses$attempted_sample &
  ctdna_analyses$ctdna_error_derived == 0L
if (any(ctdna_analyses$valid_ctdna_result !=
        ctdna_analyses$valid_ctdna_result_derived)) {
  stop("Exported and LOD-derived ctDNA analysis validity flags disagree.")
}

analysis_by_sample <- ctdna_analyses |>
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    analysis_date = if (all(is.na(analysis_date))) as.Date(NA) else
      min(analysis_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_mut = sum(n_mut[valid_ctdna_result_derived], na.rm = TRUE),
    analysis_attempted = any(attempted_sample),
    analysis_valid = any(valid_ctdna_result_derived),
    ctdna_error_qc = if (length(unique(ctdna_error[!is.na(ctdna_error)])) == 1L) {
      as.integer(unique(ctdna_error[!is.na(ctdna_error)]))
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ctdna <- dplyr::left_join(ctdna, analysis_by_sample, by = "sample_id")
if (anyNA(ctdna$analysis_valid) || any(ctdna$valid_ctdna_result != ctdna$analysis_valid)) {
  stop("Exported and analysis-derived sample validity flags disagree.")
}

ctdna$attempted_sample <- !is.na(ctdna$sample_date)
ctdna$valid_ctdna_result <- ctdna$analysis_valid
ctdna$analysis_attempted <- NULL
ctdna$analysis_valid <- NULL
ctdna$ctdna_error_derived <- as.integer(
  ctdna$attempted_sample & !ctdna$valid_ctdna_result
)

analysis_lookup <- ctdna_analyses[c(
  "analysis_id", "sample_id", "id", "valid_ctdna_result_derived"
)]
alterations <- merge(
  alterations, analysis_lookup, by = "analysis_id", all.x = TRUE,
  suffixes = c("", ".analysis"), sort = FALSE
)
if (anyNA(alterations$valid_ctdna_result_derived)) {
  stop("Every alteration must refer to a ctDNA analysis in ctdna_analyses.parquet.")
}
if (any(alterations$sample_id != alterations$sample_id.analysis) ||
    any(alterations$id != alterations$id.analysis)) {
  stop("Alteration sample/patient links disagree with ctdna_analyses.")
}
if (any(alterations$valid_ctdna_result != alterations$valid_ctdna_result_derived)) {
  stop("Exported alteration and analysis validity flags disagree.")
}
alterations$valid_ctdna_result <- alterations$valid_ctdna_result_derived
alterations$sample_id.analysis <- NULL
alterations$id.analysis <- NULL
alterations$valid_ctdna_result_derived <- NULL
sample_lookup <- ctdna[c("sample_id", "ctdna_detected")]
names(sample_lookup)[2L] <- "ctdna_detected_from_sample"
if (any(!alterations$sample_id %in% sample_lookup$sample_id)) {
  stop("Every alteration must refer to a ctDNA sample in ctdna_samples.parquet.")
}
alterations <- merge(alterations, sample_lookup, by = "sample_id", all.x = TRUE)
alterations$ctdna_detected <- alterations$ctdna_detected_from_sample
alterations$ctdna_detected_from_sample <- NULL

datasets <- list(
  recruitment = recruitment,
  cohort_follow_up = cohort,
  qol = qol,
  taooh = taooh,
  ctdna_samples = ctdna,
  ctdna_analyses = ctdna_analyses,
  alterations = alterations
)
for (domain in names(datasets)) {
  arrow::write_parquet(
    datasets[[domain]],
    output_paths[[domain]],
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}

build_status <- data.frame(
  domain = domains,
  n_rows = vapply(datasets, nrow, integer(1)),
  status = "built",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
arrow::write_parquet(build_status, status_path, compression = "zstd")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: build-status
#| tbl-cap: "Analysis datasets"
#| echo: false

build_status |>
  knitr::kable()
```
